hotfixes.symptom: fresh sessions after 0.6.0 install: '/delegate' absent — extension load failed: Cannot find module './ask.ts'
hotfixes.rootCause: package.json files allowlist predates the goal; background.ts and ask.ts were never added, so the published tarball omitted both. Source-tree tests (npm test/prepack) cannot catch this — they import from the source, not the tarball.
hotfixes.fix: 0.6.1: both modules added to files; new tests/tarball.test.ts (3 tests) asserts every root runtime module is in the allowlist and every relative .ts import resolves inside the shipped set — runs in npm test and therefore in prepack, blocking future broken publishes
hotfixes.verify: pi -p '/delegate status' in a fresh session renders v0.6.1 incl. the background inventory line; store copy contains ask.ts + background.ts
hotfixes.note: goal-run gates were all green because they exercise the source tree; the publish flow lacked a tarball-content gate — now closed
